title.narrative: Accelerating Affordable and Inclusive Rooftop Solar Systems Development Program

description.narrative: The principal objective of the Programmatic Approach is to increase share of solar energy in electricity consumption mix and enhance service quality with adequate, reliable, sustainable, and affordable electricity for low- and middle-income consumers; and improve financial health of the power sector. The Programmatic Approach comprises two subprograms and the Program is the first subprogram. The Program scope includes the following reform areas: (a) implementing comprehensive schemes including uniform operational guidelines and standards for inclusive development of residential high-quality rooftop solar (RTS) systems; (b) facilitating mass adoption of RTS systems, private sector participation, and renewable-energy-ready grids; and (c) supporting skills and knowledge to support projects, innovation, and livelihood generation activities. The Program is described in more detail in the Policy Letter and the PDMF.
